```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("/Users/wilibeltran/Desktop/CourseFolders/DS2003/Project3/bmw_global_sales_2018_2025.csv")

head(df)
```

```{r}
df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Year, Region) %>%
  summarise(Units_Sold = sum(Units_Sold), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = Year, y = Units_Sold, color = Region)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "BMW Sales Over Time by Region",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Units Sold",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
df_summary %>%
  filter(Region %in% c("Europe", "USA")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = Units_Sold, color = Region)) +
  geom_line()
```
